bayts.text: upon him whose name is Muṭahhar (the Purified), and the Family and the Companions who excelled.
And bless, with a goodly peace, him whom You named Ṭayyib (the Good),
the Family and the Companions endowed with merits, O best of those with whom intimate converse is held, with watchfulness.
Bless and grant peace, O my Supporter, upon him whom You named Sayyid (Master),
the Family and the Companions, stars for others, O You Who guided me to doing good.
Bless and grant peace, O Beautiful (Al-Jamīl), O You from Whom what I hope for reaches me fulfilled,
upon him whose name is Rasūl (Messenger), just as through him my request has come to me from You.
his Family and his Companions; and make this composition the greatest good pleasure that may be rendered.
Bless and grant peace, O Patron (Al-Waliyy), upon him whose name is Nabiyy (Prophet),
his Family and his shrewd Companions, O You Who through him illumine my reasoning.
Bless and grant peace, O Lord of grace, upon him who is named Messenger of mercy,
his Family and his chosen Companions, O You Who guided me without otherness.
Bless and grant peace, O Lord of generosity, upon the Prophet, the Chosen, the revered,
the Family and the Companions, people of light, O You Who protected me from defamation.
And bless and grant peace, O Benefactor (An-Nāfiʿ), O You from Whom benefits reach me fulfilled,
upon him whom You named Qayyim (the Upright), and the Family and the Companions, people of noble traits.
O Master Whom the assemblies worship, bless a man of worth whose name is Jāmiʿ (the Uniter),
the Family and the Companions, people of glory; and grant peace, O You Who enrich through ecstasy.
O You Whose guidance and good pleasure I follow, bless a man of worth whose name is Muqtafī (the Follower in the footsteps),
his Family and his Companions, radiant suns, O Everlasting Who protected from the graves.
And grant him peace together with them all, O best Guide, Benefactor, All-Hearing.
Bless and grant peace, O You Who grant (a place in) the ranks, upon him whose name is Muqaffī (the Last to Come),
his Family and his honoured Companions, O You: for Your noble Face I do not lie.
Bless and grant peace, O best merciful Guide, upon the Messenger (sent) from You with the great battles,
upon the Family with his beloved Companions, O You Who through him free from need of (secondary) causes.
Bless and grant peace, O You Who grant rest, upon Your Prophet, the Messenger of rest,
his Family and the Companions endowed with guidance, O You Who protected all of me and guided my heart.
Bless and grant peace, O Intimate of the hopeful, upon him whom You named Kāmil (the Perfect),
his Family and his Companions; and make my hope easy for me, and accept the work from me.
Bless and grant peace upon Iklīl (the Crown), Your beloved, set foremost, the intimate friend,
his Family and his Companions, lions, O You Who guard from the harm of the envier.
Bless a man of worth through whom You multiply my reward and my joy: he is the Muddaththir (the Cloaked One),
O You Who through him set right for me what had been corrupted, making the envious one who envied despair of me,
and grant him peace with the noble Family and the Companions, O You Who bestow on me what I aspire to.
Bless and grant peace, O Beautifier, upon him whose name is the Muzzammil (the Enwrapped),
his Family and his refined Companions; and gladden with this composition those brought near.
Bless and grant peace, O my God, upon him whom You named ʿAbd Allāh (Servant of Allah),
his Family and his Companions at every time; and with You make me the joy of the righteous.
Bless, with the peace of the Exalted, Allah, him who is named Ḥabīb Allāh (Beloved of Allah),
his Family and his favoured Companions; and for ever gladden the venerated through me.
Bless and grant peace, O my God, upon him who is named Ṣafiyy Allāh (Pure Chosen of Allah),
the Family and the Companions, O Lord of goodness; and accept with thanks my open and my secret.
Bless and grant peace, O my God, upon him who is named Najiyy Allāh (Confidant of Allah),
the Family and the Companions, lords of bounty; and through me gladden them, O best of Patrons.
Bless and grant peace, O my God, upon him who is named Kalīm Allāh (He to whom Allah spoke),
his Family and his Companions of lofty aspirations, O You Who turn evil touches toward others than me.
Bless the Seal of all the prophets and the Seal of all the messengers, my Lord,
his Family and his Companions, and grant peace, O You Who turn pain toward others than me.
Bless and grant peace, O Nourisher (Al-Muqīt) Who gives life, upon him whom You named Muḥyī (the Reviver),
his Family and the Companions, people of precedence, O You Who give life to whom You will and make abide.
Bless and grant peace, O Preserver Who rescues, upon him whom You named Munjī (the Rescuer),
his Family and his heroic Companions, O You Who efface sloth and procrastination.
Bless a man of worth whose name is Dhākir (the Rememberer), with peace, O You to Whom thanksgivings belong,
his Family and his Companions of excellence, O You in Whom I trusted in undertaking (this work).
Bless him whose name is Mudhakkir (the Admonisher), O You Who remember with You the servant who remembers (You),
and grant him peace, with the illustrious Family and his Companions, and accept with thanks this composition before You.
Bless a man of worth whose name is Nāṣir (the Helper), O You through Whom a helper comes toward me,
granting him peace, with the illustrious Family and his Companions, and accept this composition.
Bless and grant peace, O Helper (An-Naṣīr), upon him whose name is Manṣūr (the Aided),
his Family and his Companions, the Anṣār (the Helpers), O Guardian of towns and cities.
